what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1966?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1966 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (126 pages) was searched for gross wages, wages paid, payroll and salary and found only aggregates (the accountant's wage and salary lines, p29-32; payroll deductions, p23), the proposed Classification and Salary Schedule (p60, landed as `report-classification-plan`, a proposal not a pay) and the school staff listing (p100-107), which names staff, education and years and prints no pay (sources/data/report-tables/1966/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1966 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What did each special revenue and revolving fund take in, spend and carry forward in 1966, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1966 report prints the revolving accounts only as lines of the balance sheet and the receipts and payments (school lunch and athletic receipts p24, appropriation balances p19) and inside the School Department's own statements (p115-118); no town-wide receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund. Searched special revenue, revolving, capital project and capital plan: the only hit is `revolving` on p10, in prose (sources/data/report-tables/1966/). — closes: the Town Accountant's calendar-1966 special revenue and capital project fund ledgers.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for 1966?
why: `report-valuation` holds the valuation and levy history from the 1987-2010 reports. The 1966 report prints the assessed valuation and tax rate as lines of the opening facts page (p2: real estate $11,241,950, personal property $956,045, tax rate $88.00), the Assessors' prose on the State's equalized valuation of $38,000,000 reduced to $34,000,000 (p7, p11), and the overlay only as a reserve (p19, p64); no recapitulation of the levy or growth. Searched valuation, overlay and tax rate (sources/data/report-tables/1966/). — closes: the Assessors' 1966 tax rate recapitulation filed with the State.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1966, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and `sealing-fee-schedule` the fee per device from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1966 report gives the Inspector's year in prose (p61) and the Treasurer's receipts one line, `Inspector of Weights and Measures` $270.50 (p23), with no count or fee by device type. Searched weights and measures, sealer and sealing (sources/data/report-tables/1966/). — closes: the Inspector of Weights and Measures' 1966 test and fee record.
